subject: ZenPay vendor portal SSO, invoice proofs, and PO acceptance pathway
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Reeves <tim.reeves@zenpay.com>, ZenPay Billing <billing@zenpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ZenPay vendor portal SSO, invoice proofs, and PO acceptance pathway

Hi Tim / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier — we're ready to finish the vendor activation but wanted to align on a couple of items so our AP system issues clean invoices that map to your PO flow. Key asks:

1) Vendor portal SSO: we plan to use SAML SSO and would like the assertion to contain the vendor_id (redwood_vendor_823) and email attribute. Can you confirm the attribute name you expect for the vendor_id?

2) Invoice URN requirement: your API expects an invoiceURN string in metadata; our billing system can emit two formats. Please confirm whether you need the long-format (urn:zenpay:inv:2026:RID-000123) or the compact numeric (ZP-000123). We can provide a sample CSV mapping.

3) PO acceptance policy: when a PO number is present on the invoice we will attach it to the invoice meta. What's the expected PO state in ZenPay for automatic acceptance vs. manual review? (open | confirmed | approved_by_procurement)

4) VAT evidence for EU deal lines: for any reverse-charge items we'd like to confirm the proof you require (vendor VAT id + certificate file OR vendor self-attestation + customer-side document).

I've attached our AP onboarding packet and a sample invoice URN mapping (two rows). If it helps, Marissa can join a short technical call to finalize SSO attributes and the invoice webhook schema.

Next step: can we get your answers by EOD Monday so we don't delay activation?

Thanks,

Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v1.3.pdf (application/pdf), example-invoice-URN-mapping.csv (text/csv)

From: Timothy Reeves <tim.reeves@zenpay.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@zenpay.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: ZenPay vendor portal SSO, invoice proofs, and PO acceptance pathway

Thanks Avery — quick answers inline.

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 9:12 AM Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> 1) Vendor portal SSO: we plan to use SAML SSO and would like the assertion to contain the vendor_id (redwood_vendor_823) and email attribute. Can you confirm the attribute name you expect for the vendor_id?

We expect attribute name "vendor_external_id" (string). Email should be standard "email". We'll mirror the vendor_external_id into the portal profile and use it as the canonical join key.

> 2) Invoice URN requirement: your API expects an invoiceURN string in metadata; our billing system can emit two formats. Please confirm whether you need the long-format (urn:zenpay:inv:2026:RID-000123) or the compact numeric (ZP-000123).

Either is acceptable from ZenPay's validation perspective, but the long-format is preferred (we use URN namespace in reporting). If you send the compact form we will normalize it server-side.

> 3) PO acceptance policy: when a PO number is present on the invoice we will attach it to the invoice meta. What's the expected PO state in ZenPay for automatic acceptance vs. manual review? (open | confirmed | approved_by_procurement)

Automatic acceptance requires the PO to be in "confirmed" state and match supplier_id on file. If PO is "open" it will route for manual procurement confirmation. If there is a line-item mismatch we'll flag as review.

> 4) VAT evidence for EU deal lines: for any reverse-charge items we'd like to confirm the proof you require (vendor VAT id + certificate file OR vendor self-attestation + customer-side document).

For reverse-charge we need vendor VAT id + a PDF of VAT registration OR your EU self-attestation plus the customer's VAT id on the PO. A scanned certificate is ideal for automated acceptance.

We'll add the SSO attribute guide to the vendor onboarding page. Tentatively available for a quick call Monday 10:00-10:30 PT if that works.

—Tim
Timothy Reeves
Head of Vendor Integrations
ZenPay Billing

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Reeves <tim.reeves@zenpay.com>, ZenPay Billing <billing@zenpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: ZenPay vendor portal SSO, invoice proofs, and PO acceptance pathway

Hi Tim — thanks for the clear answers. A few follow-ups:

• vendor_external_id: confirmed. We'll ensure the SAML assertion includes vendor_external_id and email. Our SSO engineer will send metadata once the IdP entity is ready.

• URN: we'll adopt the long-format urn:zenpay:inv:YYYY:RID-XXXXX for our outgoing invoices. Attached is a 2-line CSV showing our mapping rule for invoice numbers to URN.

• PO acceptance: understood about "confirmed" state requirement and supplier_id matching. Two questions: 1) if the PO is confirmed but the invoice total differs by <1.5% due to currency rounding, do you still auto-accept? 2) are partial-ship invoices allowed and how should we annotate partiality in the metadata?

• VAT evidence: we'll attach the VAT registration PDF for any EU reverse-charge lines. For UK customers where EORI applies we'll include EORI in the invoice meta.

Action items:
- Marissa will coordinate a 30m technical call to finalize SSO attribute names and test the webhook payload.
- Karthik will share a sample invoice JSON schema with the long-format URN and PO partiality fields annotated.

Marissa / Karthik — can you share availability for Tue (Nov 17) morning PT?

Thanks,
Avery

> Attachments: example-invoice-URN-mapping.csv (text/csv)

Marissa
